objectives.text: Read the duty roster in Warden's Walk.
Find the Hall of the First Oath (Level 4).
Speak with Mira at the catacombs entrance.
Bring scavenged equipment from the upper halls.
Pass three torch-lit junctions without dying.
Find the priest's confession in the Confessor's Cell.
Recover the Merciful Ash from the plague pit.
Recover the stolen delver's map from a goblin camp.
Return the map to the marked cache.
Survive three trap rooms without using a ward-stone.
Find Serene's letter behind the royal blockade.
Take the Pale Seal from the Pale Vault.
Use a golem tear at the cracked statue in the Foundry.
Read the inscription on the crimson axe.
Find the hidden alcove in Serene's Blockade.

wardens_ledger_roster.title: Crumbling Duty Roster
pages:
Third Warden's Watch — roster of the reliquary ring.

The crown of King Aldric the Remembered was removed from the reliquary ring for safekeeping.
It was hidden where the wardens swore their first oath — beyond the ring, in the Hall of the First Oath.
None of us were meant to leave this post alive. If you read this, delver, the oath-stone niche still holds what we could not protect.

first_meeting: You're the one they call the Lantern, aren't you?
I pay good coin for equipment from the upper halls — anything a delver doesn't need to keep breathing.
Bring me gear from the crypts and I'll make it worth your while.
quest_active: Scavenge any weapon, armor, or trinket from the Entry Crypt or Warden's Walk and bring it here.
turn_in_ready: That looks like proper catacomb steel. Hand it over.
Take these — you'll need them deeper down.
quest_complete: You've paid your keep for now, delver.
The merchants on the surface remember who feeds them.
default: The catacombs don't give gifts. They lend them until something hungrier shows up.
